text: On Wednesday 18 November, the cheapest 2 hours to run the washing machine are forecast to start at 03:00, at a wholesale price of about 150 EUR/MWh. The most expensive start at 18:00, at about 222 EUR/MWh. These are forecasts of market prices, not household prices.

On Thursday 19 November, the cheapest 2 hours to run the washing machine are forecast to start at 03:00, at a wholesale price of about 81 EUR/MWh. The most expensive start at 17:00, at about 183 EUR/MWh. These are forecasts of market prices, not household prices.
